snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies - Gameplay Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Taken from the #ZEROPARADES: For Dead Spies Showcase, which debuted on Steam last week. Watch the full video now on our YouTube channel. 

This five-minute, ZERO PARADES gameplay deep dive is hosted by our V/O Director, Writer and IMPRINT Devcast presenter: Jim Ashilevi. 

Narrated by Ruudu Ulas (Lead Producer), Nicolas Pirot (Lead Technical Artist) and Siim "Kosmos" Sinamäe (Principal Writer), the deep-dive preps you with all you need to know about ZERO PARADES and Portofiro before you dive in. 

ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies release across PC on MAY 21ST. Wishlist now to be notified.
